text:
Ivy: Heads-up — felt like the tide came through the plaza this morning, lots of standing water by the bike racks. Anyone else?
commute-bot: LOCAL ALERT: Heavy runoff causing pooling around South Plaza and lower garage entrance. Expect wet walkways; cleaning crew notified.
Ned: Yep, the splash from a passing truck drenched my messenger bag. Note to self: plastic bag-lined backpack is a genius hack.
Tara: Lost an umbrella to what looked like a coordinated theft ring near the lookout. If you see a neon-pink compact umbrella wandering free, that's mine. :crying_cat_face:
Felix: Also saw a tiny concession cart giving out free espresso shots at 8:10 which probably drew a crowd and slowed the ferry boarding. Worth the delay TBH. :coffee:
Facilities: Facilities note: lower garage sump pump handled initial runoff; maintenance will check floors at 09:45. Please avoid spots near column E3 until then.
Ivy: Thanks @Facilities. Parking tip — rooftop level seems drier this morning if you can swing it.
commute-bot: TRANSIT: F-Line reduced frequency due to street flooding near Market/Embarcadero; alternative: temporary shuttle between Embarcadero and Pier 3.
Ned: Pro tip: I keep an old pair of crocs under my desk labeled "rain escape" for days like this. Cheap salvation.
Tara: Small plan  11:30 coffee in the kitchen for anyone who wants to trade disaster commute stories and dry off. React :raised_hands: if you're coming.
Felix: :raised_hands: I'll bring napkins and a jar of instant hand warmers.
Ivy: :raised_hands: I'll bring spare umbrella clips (they're a thing).
Facilities: Maintenance will leave a couple of wet-floor cones by the lower lobby and a towel by elevator 1. Report any problems to facilities@.
Tara: Also shoutout to the stranger who handed out hot cocoa at the pier — small humans of the city are wholesome.
Ivy: Alright team, watch your step and may your shoes stay at least mostly dry.
